defects.title: Unreadable type and broken colors
defects.notes: Comic Sans, clashing yellow/magenta, no box-sizing.

defects.title: Header overlaps and floats apart
defects.notes: Brand, generation chip, and Improve button sit on top of each other.

defects.title: No page layout
defects.notes: Shell is too wide, hero is rotated, KPIs float and overflow.

defects.title: Pipeline and widgets have no structure
defects.notes: Steps and worker cards are raw blocks with no rhythm.

defects.title: Depth tree and memory are unusable
defects.notes: Nested nodes collapse; memory of prior work is easy to miss.

defects.title: No quality pass or mobile layout
defects.notes: No spacing system, no responsive stack, no visual hierarchy.

history.title: Readable type and color system
history.summary: Replaced the broken type with a real dark palette, box-sizing, and Instrument Sans.
history.notes: Highest-quality base tokens. Later patches must keep contrast and box-sizing.

history.title: Header that actually lays out
history.summary: Separated brand, generation memory, and the Improve action so they no longer overlap.
history.notes: Chip and primary button stay on one row on desktop.

history.title: Page width, hero, and KPI grid
history.summary: Constrained the shell, un-rotated the hero, and put the 10k stats on a real grid.
history.notes: Do not let KPIs float or the shell exceed the viewport.

history.title: Pipeline and widget cards
history.summary: Gave planner / worker / verifier / merge and worker widgets a shared card language.
history.notes: Tone stripes stay; no dotted magenta leftovers.

history.title: Recursive tree and agent memory
history.summary: Made the depth tree scannable and pinned the memory of every accepted repair.
history.notes: Memory is the source of truth. Do not hide open defects.

history.title: Quality pass and mobile stack
history.summary: Tightened spacing, shadows, and a one-column mobile layout so the repaired UI holds up in a screenshot.
history.notes: Last open defect. After this the agent has rebuilt the console from memory.

doNotRegress: Page width, hero, and KPI grid
